title: Clarify evaluator interfaces and add fallback tracing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refactor the smart routing evaluator interfaces to a smaller, well-documented surface and add structured fallback tracing hooks. Goals: 1) Reduce per-request routing decision latency by decoupling policy evaluation from regional affinity lookups; 2) Eliminate duplicated region lookup code paths; 3) Add end-to-end tracing for fallback reasons (capacity, model mismatch, region outage) to aid postmortems and SLO alerts; 4) Upgrade the routing-core dependency to v2.4 and run a compatibility pass on kernel selection logic. This ticket covers API-level interface changes, instrumentation, unit/integration tests, and a coordinated rollout with a small 10% canary traffic shift.
comments: 2025-09-10 - Maya Chen: RFC posted (link in attachments). High-level plan: introduce EvaluatorV2 interface with two phases: decide(primary policy) and enrich(affinity/capacity hints). We're keeping the old Evaluator for backwards compatibility and will add an adapter that logs deprecation warnings.

2025-09-11 - Arjun Patel: Spike completed. Measured existing routing decision median=1.8ms (p99 12ms) in staging. Prototype with separate affinity cache reduced median to 1.1ms and p99 to 6.3ms. Trade-off: additional single-key KV cache adds ~0.2ms on cache miss for enrich step but massively reduces repeated region lookups.

2025-09-12 - Design review (Kenji Sato): Approved tracing schema. We'll emit structured fallback events with fields: reason, affected_model, attempted_variants, region, observed_capacity. Kept schema minimal to avoid high-cardinality tags in metrics.

2025-09-13 - Security (Priya Rao): Quick review - no secrets in traces; ensure PII scrubber runs on any arbitrary input logged by adapter. Marked security_review_required=false but requested a follow-up for audit-log alignment.

2025-09-14 - Arjun Patel: Opened PR #8342 with EvaluatorV2, adapter, and affinity-cache. Basic unit tests added. Bench harness shows 35% fewer region-database calls under mixed traffic. Requesting review from runtime- infra team.

2025-09-16 - Code review (Diego Alvarez): Left review comments re: context propagation across async tasks and potential goroutine leaks. Suggested using the centralized request-trace ID rather than goroutine-local storage. Also requested an explicit migration plan for third-party consumers of routing-core.

2025-09-17 - Arjun Patel: Addressed Diego's comments. Added request-trace propagation, fixed potential leak, and added integration tests simulating region failover. Added canary rollout plan in PR description.

2025-09-18 - Maya Chen: Runbook draft for fallback alerts and incident playbook attached. Plan: 10% canary for 48 hours, check fallback-trace rate and p99 decision latency; if fallback reasons spike >2x baseline open rollback. Next: finalize canary dashboard and schedule cross-team deployment sync on 2025-09-20.
Notes: Keep this ticket focused on routing-side changes only. Upgrades to other services that consume routing-core will be tracked in downstream tickets.
